svg.title: MOOTx01 complete kit topology
svg.desc: Full dependency stack: SubstrateLib at bottom, foundation libs, storage layer, standalone substrate, GeniusLocusKit composition layer (the buttons), NeuronKit (coordination/daemons/AutonomicGovernor), CognitionKit (executes commands), ARIA_MCP interface/host.

g.text: subconscious mind · algorithms · daemons · autonomic governor

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about GeniusLocusKit — the Spirit of the Place — the layer with the buttons')
g.text: N estates · nine verbs · signal registry · data custodian
the buttons · emits standing signals · one queue per estate
